### Problem Formulation
Clearly state the scientific or methodological question to be addressed.

### Relevant Literature Context
Cite key prior papers from `docs/research/literature-review.md` or new literature relevant to this question.

### Specific Hypothesis
Formulate the hypothesis:
> `[HYPOTHESIS]: ...`

### Proposed Empirical Investigation
1. Which module or experimental pipeline is needed to test this?
2. What independent variables will be manipulated (e.g. synchronization intervals, fault injection magnitude)?
3. What quantitative metrics will decide the hypothesis (e.g., RMSE degradation rate, AUC-ROC drop)?

### Impact on Overall Study Scope
Does this question fit within the core project scope (staleness impact on IEEE 33-bus hybrid simulation) or represent an expansion?
- [ ] Fits core scope (RQ1–RQ4)
- [ ] Potential future work / extension
